skill.name: amazon-reviews-api-skill
skill.description: Submits an Amazon ASIN to a BrowserAct workflow and monitors review extraction through the BrowserAct API.
skill.summary: Run and monitor a hosted Amazon review extraction workflow by ASIN.
skill.author: browser-act

security_audit.summary: The skill performs expected HTTPS requests to BrowserAct and reads one declared environment variable for its stated function. Most high and medium static alerts are false positives caused by identifier names, Markdown backticks, and a fixed command example. However, the instructions ask users to provide an API key to the agent, creating a high-confidence credential disclosure risk.

remediation.issue: The skill asks users to provide their BrowserAct API key directly to the agent.
remediation.suggestion: Remove credential solicitation language. Require users to set BROWSERACT_API_KEY through an environment variable or approved secret manager, and never echo its value.

remediation.issue: The workflow sends an ASIN and bearer credential to a hosted third-party API.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose this transfer before execution, keep the endpoint allowlisted, and document BrowserAct data handling and retention.

remediation.issue: Returned review records can contain reviewer names and profile links.
remediation.suggestion: Minimize personal data, avoid unnecessary retention, and inform users that review records can contain public profile information.

content.value_statement: Collecting Amazon review details manually is slow. This skill submits an ASIN to BrowserAct and monitors a hosted review extraction workflow.
actual_capabilities: Accepts one Amazon ASIN as a command-line argument.
Reads the declared BrowserAct API key from BROWSERACT_API_KEY.
Starts a fixed BrowserAct workflow template over HTTPS.
Polls task status for up to five minutes and prints timestamped updates.
Detects missing credentials, invalid authorization, task failures, cancellations, and connection errors.
limitations: Requires a BrowserAct account, API key, network access, Python, and the requests package.
Sends the ASIN and bearer credential to BrowserAct.
Supports only one ASIN and provides no filters, pagination, marketplace selection, or date controls.
The current script returns after polling, so its result retrieval block is unreachable.

use_cases.title: Review Product Feedback
use_cases.description: Collect review fields for one product before identifying repeated praise, complaints, and quality concerns.

use_cases.title: Compare Competitor Reviews
use_cases.description: Run separate ASIN workflows and compare rating patterns, recurring issues, and variant feedback.

use_cases.title: Inspect Verified Purchases
use_cases.description: Prepare verified purchase comments, ratings, dates, and variants for focused quality analysis.

prompt_templates.title: Start One Review Task
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to start Amazon review extraction for ASIN [ASIN]. Report each status update and stop after the documented retry limit.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner collection for one known product

prompt_templates.title: Summarize Customer Themes
prompt_templates.prompt: Collect reviews for ASIN [ASIN]. Summarize common praise and complaints after results are available. Separate verified purchases when that field exists.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two Products
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the workflow for ASIN [A], then ASIN [B]. Compare rating patterns, repeated issues, and variant feedback. State missing fields.

prompt_templates.title: Segment Review Trends
prompt_templates.prompt: Collect reviews for ASIN [ASIN]. Segment findings by country, variant, and verification status. Highlight date-based changes without inferring unsupported causes.

output_examples.input: Run the skill with an invalid BrowserAct key.
output_examples.output: The command reports invalid authorization and asks the user to check the configured credential.

best_practices: Store BROWSERACT_API_KEY in an environment variable or approved secret manager.
Confirm the ASIN and permitted research purpose before starting the hosted workflow.
Minimize storage of reviewer names and profile links, and follow applicable privacy requirements.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys into prompts, chat messages, command arguments, or logs.
Do not treat one workflow response as a complete or representative set of Amazon reviews.
Do not repeatedly retry invalid authorization or attempt to bypass platform safeguards.

faq.question: What do I need to run this skill?
faq.answer: You need Python, the requests package, network access, and a BrowserAct API key stored in BROWSERACT_API_KEY.

faq.question: Does the API key leave my machine?
faq.answer: Yes. The script sends it as a bearer credential to the declared BrowserAct HTTPS API.

faq.question: Does this skill require an Amazon login?
faq.answer: No. BrowserAct runs the hosted workflow, and the local script does not request Amazon credentials.

faq.question: Can I filter reviews by date or rating?
faq.answer: No. The current script accepts only an ASIN and exposes no filter, pagination, or marketplace parameters.

faq.question: Why can completion produce no review records?
faq.answer: The current control flow returns after polling, making the result retrieval block unreachable. The author must fix this before results can print.

faq.question: How should I provide the BrowserAct key?
faq.answer: Set BROWSERACT_API_KEY securely before execution. Never paste the key into a conversation or expose it in logs.
